title: Mirror of Arcane Reflection
description: A woman in a red and green robe stands in a mystical purple room, holding a glowing orb while touching an ornate magical mirror that reflects her image and the surrounding laboratory. An open spellbook with runes, potion bottles, scrolls, and a hanging lantern fill the detailed scene.
prompt: A sorceress in flowing red and green robes stands in a mystical purple laboratory filled with potion bottles, scrolls, and hanging lanterns. She holds a glowing orb in one hand while touching an ornate golden mirror with intricate designs. The mirror reflects her image and the room with magical teal light emanating from it. An open spellbook with glowing runes lies in the foreground. Highly detailed fantasy illustration with rich colors and magical atmosphere.
